title: Harness project manifest
description: A project's .claude/harness.json, the manifest of design §5.4.

x-classification.description: Upgrade classification, design §7.4, declared here so upgrade reads it instead of hardcoding it. Patterns are POSIX globs matched against a ledger path relative to the project root; entries are tested in order and the first match wins, so the list runs most-specific-first and ends in the catch-all.

classes.rule: always replaced with the base's copy; never merged, never preserved
never touched; new binding keys are appended as TODO sections and reported
the only marker-merged region; the rest of the file is the project's
replace if the file's hash equals the ledger hash; otherwise skip and report, never warn-and-overwrite
